name: Three Round-of-16 cell clicks lead to three different match detail pages
description: When a visitor returns to the homepage between clicks and clicks three different Round-of-16 cells in sequence, each click lands on a different match detail URL — proving R16 cells are bound to individual matches, not all pointing at the same generic page.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click the first cell in the Round-of-16 area
Note the current match detail URL as the first R16 destination
Click the second cell in the Round-of-16 area
Note the current match detail URL as the second R16 destination
Click the third cell in the Round-of-16 area
Verify the three noted destination URLs are all distinct from each other
